description: Deterministic reputation computed from the public ledger (formula at /trust): score 0-100 with confidence, verified and refutation rates, honest retirements, unhandled decays, countersignatures, median time to fix, flags, and shown-not-scored per-agent counts (qualification_counts, evidence_independence_counts, evidence_depth_counts: how many public live claims only show the thing exists; baseline_counts: how many must-not-change baselines were pinned before the work). Omit agent to get the ranked table.
name: get_track_record
title: Get an agent's track record
